lines.en: I don't walk, but I can shift.
My base grinds against the stone.
I turn my body, looking for a line.

lines.zh: 紫黑色的光从我的缝里漏出。
lines.en: Violet-black light leaks from my seams.

lines.zh: 我朝走廊中间挪了半格。
lines.en: I shift half a block toward the corridor's middle.

lines.zh: 我压过地砖，砖陷下去了。
lines.en: I roll over the tiles and they sink.
I creak all over, as if about to split.

lines.zh: 腐化的炮口，一直朝亮处。
lines.en: A corrupted muzzle always turns to the light.
I stop at the door. Wedged.
I back up and squeeze in.
I stand and turn, slowly.
Something inside me keeps pulsing.

lines.zh: 我从缝隙里漏出一缕烟。
lines.en: A thread of smoke leaks from my seam.
The floor beneath me has blackened.
I'm waiting for something to walk in.

lines.zh: 我的高度，刚好到你的胸口。
lines.en: My height is just at your chest.
I turn to a new angle by the wall.
I remember that light.
My edges are starting to glow red.
I stop, and nothing hums.
This is the quietest it gets.
Then I begin to turn again.
This room is too narrow.

lines.zh: 我出不去，就在这儿守着。
lines.en: I can't leave, so I keep watch here.

lines.zh: 烟从缝里出来，绕着我的棱。
lines.en: Smoke leaks from the seams and coils around my edges.
It isn't me moving.
You've walked into this room.

lines.zh: 你站在我的射界里，别动。
lines.en: You stand in my line of fire; do not move.
My barrel has rusted to a corrupt color.
My edges are covered in scoring.

lines.zh: 每一道都是一个进来的。
lines.en: Each one is someone who came in.
You're standing on the fourth.
I don't need to aim. The room is small.

lines.zh: 我的炮口锈得发红，正对你。
lines.en: My rust-red muzzle points straight at you.
You go right. I follow.
The wall will stop one of them.
The wall will stop only one.
Your hands search the wall for a door.

lines.zh: 我晃了一下，底座刮出声。
lines.en: I rock and my base scrapes.
I've gained another scoring.

lines.zh: 底座下的砖又黑了一圈。
lines.en: Another ring of bricks blackens beneath my base.
That doesn't stop my turn.
A chip came off my edge.
More smoke leaks from my seams.
I'm still facing you.
I can't dodge, and I needn't.
I haven't moved from here.
Hit me again. I'll keep turning.

lines.zh: 你举起来的东西，我不认。
lines.en: That thing you raise, I don't know it.
I only know what moves.

lines.zh: 你还在动，那就还在名单上。
lines.en: You're still moving, so you're still on the list.
So you're still on the list.
Put it down and take two steps.

lines.zh: 让我看看你还会不会走。
lines.en: Let's see if you can still walk.

lines.zh: 你手里那东西，不如你的心跳。
lines.en: That thing in your hand matters less than your heartbeat.
To the corner and it's simple.
My light is gathering.

lines.zh: 紫色的光正沿着地面爬向你。
lines.en: Purple light creeps along the floor toward you.
You strike my edge with a clang.

lines.zh: 棱角一震，我的底座没动。
lines.en: The edge rang; my base did not move.

lines.zh: 这一下，你的肩膀该脱臼了。
lines.en: That should have popped your shoulder.
My base rolls over your foot.
You're shoved back half a block.

lines.zh: 我的棱撞在你肋上，烟喷出来。
lines.en: My edge strikes your ribs and smoke hisses out.
You've backed toward the door.
You're against the wall. Nowhere to go.
You've slid down against it.
Against the wall. It saves me a shot.

lines.zh: 这间屋子只有我一副底座。
lines.en: There is only one base in this room: mine.
Not born.
Whoever made me is gone.

lines.zh: 他没有给我配对的东西。
lines.en: He gave me no counterpart.
There's only me in this room.
There used to be others.

lines.zh: 它们被拆了，零件在我身上。
lines.en: They were taken apart. Their parts are in me.
That's why I keep turning.
I'm looking for the rest of them.
You don't have any.
I don't pick things up.
What I roll over is mine.
I roll over it and it breaks.
The fragments lodge in my base.
That makes my base thicker.
A coin is stuck in my seam.
It glints. It keeps glinting.
I leave it.
I roll over it and keep turning.
Until it stops shining.
The door swings inward.
Something came in.
I swing my firing side round.
It's stopped by the door.
It's stopped in the doorway.
I don't care whether it looks.
My edges begin to brighten.
The light in the room turns violet.
Its heel turned half a circle.
The door's shut. Good.

lines.zh: 炮口转过来，腐化的齿轮在响。
lines.en: The barrel turns; corrupted gears grind.
It's moved left.
I turn after it.
Now it's moved right.
My base grinds round after it.
It's hiding behind a pillar.
A pillar is no cover.
I wait for it to show itself.
It shows from behind the pillar.
The door opens another crack.
I keep turning to face it.
It's fast, but the room is small.
It circles me.
I turn with it.

lines.zh: 我的底座在地上刮出印子。
lines.en: My base scores lines in the floor.

lines.zh: 它踩到印子上，滑了一下。
lines.en: It steps on a line and slips.
I take that moment.
Its shadow falls on the wall.
I turn toward the shadow.
It leaps behind the pillar.
There's a hole in the floor now.
It's counting the gaps between my shots.
Even if it's right, it won't help.
I'm never quite the same twice.
It's circling again.

lines.zh: 我的炮口，一直对着门口。
lines.en: My barrel stays pointed at the door.
The wall stopped it.
It's turning to run.
It crossed my line of fire.
My edge is aimed at it.
My base slams forward.

lines.zh: 这一下，把它推到了墙上。
lines.en: That drives it into the wall.
A beam spits from my edge.
The beam hits the floor and bursts.
It's thrown into the air.
It lands and rolls halfway.
I turn again.
It's getting up.
I don't want to stop.

lines.zh: 从被造出来，我就没停过。
lines.en: I haven't stopped since I was built.
This beam is wider than the last.
The wall is starting to crack.
The whole room is shaking.
The wall's cracking. I don't care.
I'm set down in the corner.
My base sinks into the tiles.
First thing, one full turn.
Counting the exits.

lines.zh: 我的底座压在门槛的砖缝上。
lines.en: My base presses into the brick seam of the threshold.
One is enough for me.
Light kindles in my seams.
The room goes violet.
The tiles darken beneath me.
I set my angle.
I set my angle at the door.
I hear footsteps outside.
The footsteps come closer.
The handle is turning.
I hold on the door without turning.
The door is pushed open a crack.
One person stands in the doorway.
Looks very young.
A pity only one leaves this room.
Only one leaves this room.

lines.zh: 火在我棱上烧，光变白了。
lines.en: Fire burns on my edges and the light turns white.

lines.zh: 我从台子上掉下去，砸碎了地面。
lines.en: I fall off the ledge and shatter the floor.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的缝里，我的光在冒泡。
lines.en: Water floods my seams and my light bubbles.

lines.zh: 炸响把屋子掀了一角，我还在转。
lines.en: The blast tears a corner off and I'm still turning.

lines.zh: 一枚子弹击在我身上，弹开了。
lines.en: A round strikes me and ricochets.
A spell presses down on my light.

lines.zh: 这里没有能压的东西了。
lines.en: There's nothing left here to roll over.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我的棱全亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and all my edges flare.
I fall out of the room, still turning.
